what: Follow-up to 01058 (pack onto blaze_lower): a serve work kind / agent API request `pack` {project dir, program package, target wasm32-unknown-unknown, debug_assertions off} that plans with blaze_units, runs build scripts and proc macros sandboxed, lowers with blaze_lower, then calls blaze_wasm_pack::record(lowered.served_db(), lowered.krate(program unit), |db, crates| { for each crate crate_def_map(db, krate); infer every fn body of the program crate }) and returns serde_json::to_vec(&pack). record(db: &mut Db, program: Crate, expand: impl FnOnce(&Db, &[Crate])) -> Result<Pack, String> is in crates/blaze-wasm/pack (package blaze-wasm-pack; depends only on front-end crates, never on hir-ty-codegen, so no wasm feature unification). Plus a CLI client (`blaze pack <dir> <package> <out>`) replacing the removed `blaze-wasm pack`; crates/blaze-wasm/web/build-dioxus.sh stops until it exists. Needs coordinator to add blaze-wasm-pack = { path = "crates/blaze-wasm/pack" } to root [workspace.dependencies] (root members crates/* does not include it).

Root workspace dep and check asked of the coordinator.
